Troy Burne layout · Tips · Par 71

Hole 1

Par 4372 ydsWind 6 mph

Unofficial re-creation built from the mapped course layout (© OpenStreetMap contributors), USGS 3DEP elevation and published hole descriptions. Not affiliated with Troy Burne Golf Club.

  1. Aim: drag the screen left or right (or use the arrows) to turn. The ring and dotted arc show where a full-power shot lands.
  2. Look: tap the eye (or pinch the screen) to scout the hole. Drag to move, pinch to zoom, twist to turn, and tap Green to read the putting surface.
  3. Pick a shot above the meter: Full, Punch (low, runs, stays under branches), Pitch, Chip (low runner) or Flop (sky-high, stops dead).
  4. Tap Swing to start, then tap again to set power as the marker runs right.
  5. Tap a third time right on the white impact line as it comes back. Early hooks left, late slices right.
